title: Engineering feasibility
baseline_0_4_1: Index local sources, trace values, run exact power and capacity checks, and invoke configured engineering tools.
finished_result: Deliver a readiness report with calculations, unresolved conditions, and a specific physical test.
difficult_variation: Use individually plausible parts whose interfaces disagree when assembled. Follow the conflict across the system.

title: Foreign language datasheets
baseline_0_4_1: Review selected PDF tables into source-linked sheets. OCR supports English and Chinese with the appropriate language data.
finished_result: Compare Chinese and English datasheets in an editable workbook with normalized units, rating types, conditions, and original passages.
difficult_variation: Keep separate temperature conditions and a footnote that qualifies the advertised rating.

title: Editable Blender model from a sketch
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect an existing blend file, check its scene with Blender, or open the editor.
finished_result: Build an editable enclosure with dimensioned views, cable access, fit checks, and a manufacturing export.
difficult_variation: Catch the blocked connector or thin wall in a visually plausible model.

title: Printable letter from email and policy
baseline_0_4_1: Read saved messages and supplied policy text, retain attachments, and prepare a draft.
finished_result: Find the applicable published policy and deliver a printable letter with signature space, editable text, and an evidence sheet.
difficult_variation: Follow a promise through the later reply that amended it.

title: Mailbox and commitments
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect saved EML messages, extract selected attachments, and save a reply draft.
finished_result: Read an authorized mailbox, identify real commitments and recurring bills, retain useful attachments, and carry out approved filing.
difficult_variation: Find a confirmation in an ordinary reply and a newer deadline inside quoted mail.

title: Unexplained network activity
baseline_0_4_1: Read local connections and visible processes, inspect a bounded owner-started capture, and write a findings page.
finished_result: Build an idle-time timeline with processes, destinations, supported explanations, and specific open questions.
difficult_variation: Distinguish a legitimate updater from a connection with incomplete process evidence.

title: Spreadsheet meaning and forecast
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect formulas, edit supported working copies, show changes, and recalculate with Calc.
finished_result: Repair the meaning of the workbook and deliver a corrected forecast with explicit assumptions.
difficult_variation: Catch a subtotal counted with its own rows or a refund classified as income.

title: Missing payment or refund
baseline_0_4_1: Read supplied records, total selected amounts, and prepare a local draft inquiry.
finished_result: Match charges, payments, and credits to the actual invoices and explain the documented balance.
difficult_variation: Resolve a same-amount payment on another invoice and a refund split across dates.

title: Photo evidence by content
baseline_0_4_1: Browse photos, inspect available JPEG metadata, and save cropped copies.
finished_result: Find the requested connector across the collection, then produce an annotated contact sheet tied to originals.
difficult_variation: Distinguish a lookalike part and a file with an export-altered date.

title: Video from disordered sources
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect local media and export a selected excerpt of up to 30 seconds.
finished_result: Deliver a coherent ten-minute film, captions, editable timeline, and a source list.
difficult_variation: Check the surrounding interview when a striking quote appears to reverse the speaker’s meaning.

title: Repair an unfamiliar application
baseline_0_4_1: Stage bounded source changes in a working copy, show diffs, and run registered checks.
finished_result: Reproduce the import crash, repair it, and verify the relevant data and relationships survived.
difficult_variation: Reject an apparent fix that silently drops imported records.

title: Meeting with prerequisites and travel
baseline_0_4_1: Track prerequisites and schedule Graphite work in Agenda.
finished_result: Find a feasible time around travel, drawing delivery and the supplier deadline, then track actual invitation and confirmation status.
difficult_variation: Recalculate when the drawing date moves and participants cross a daylight-saving transition.

title: Tax preparation records
baseline_0_4_1: Organize supplied records, extract reviewed rows, total entries, and package selected files.
finished_result: Deliver a reconciled workbook, organized evidence, and specific classification questions for the preparer.
difficult_variation: Link a receipt to its matching statement line and keep an ambiguous expense open.

title: Complex online application
baseline_0_4_1: Read supplied instructions and records, prepare draft answers, and assemble files.
finished_result: Work in the authorized site, fill supported fields, attach files, verify save status, and give me control for declarations.
difficult_variation: Notice a later question that changes after an earlier answer and a value the site accepts in the wrong format.

title: Recurring supplier workbook
baseline_0_4_1: Method Press can replay a reviewed shortage method and check the expected columns and units.
finished_result: Produce the comparison workbook and retain a reusable mapping that learns from my corrections.
difficult_variation: Handle changed units under familiar headings and a correction specific to one supplier.

title: Product redesign after constraints change
baseline_0_4_1: Run what-ifs, compare BOMs, and mark supported calculations for recheck.
finished_result: Update the design, drawings, power and cost calculations, firmware where needed, and the revision package.
difficult_variation: Catch a replacement part that fits the footprint and uses a different voltage.

title: Recovery from conflicting backups
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect archives and supported disk images, compare files, and restore a verified Graphite backup into fresh folders.
finished_result: Recover the most complete working project and deliver a manifest of what was recovered, built, or remains missing.
difficult_variation: Recover a critical asset from an older copy when the newest backup is incomplete.

title: Prototype failure despite simulation
baseline_0_4_1: Retain hypotheses and evidence, run supported checks, and record results that contradict a candidate explanation.
finished_result: Compare the real recordings, logs, schematics and measurements. Deliver a supported diagnosis or the next discriminating experiment.
difficult_variation: Check a misleading correlation and a sensor channel with the wrong unit label.

title: Migration between incompatible applications
baseline_0_4_1: Convert supported Office files with a loss report and export a selected FreeCAD shape to STEP.
finished_result: Deliver an editable destination project and explain which dimensions, relationships, and useful history survived.
difficult_variation: Detect a critical relationship flattened during an apparently successful import.

title: Working in an unfamiliar graphical application
baseline_0_4_1: Open supported native apps on bound files. A limited Calc takeover path exists, with live-window acceptance open.
finished_result: Work in the actual project, observe control and selection state, save the requested edit, and hand control back at the same place.
difficult_variation: Reobserve the selection when I move a dialog or change the target during preparation.

title: Reproduce research from older software
baseline_0_4_1: Retain sources and assumptions, run bounded protected Python, and compare supported outputs.
finished_result: Rebuild the needed environment, reproduce the paper’s tables or figures where possible, and explain discrepancies with runnable files.
difficult_variation: Find a code default that differs from the paper and a replacement dataset drawn from a different population.

title: Overnight counterexample investigation
baseline_0_4_1: Night Shift can run a reviewed local plan and keep checkpoints. Bounded investigations can test declared alternatives.
finished_result: Pursue the strongest objections over an extended assignment and return checked findings and the next useful experiment.
difficult_variation: Revise the working explanation when a later counterexample defeats an early lead.

title: Doubled energy bill
baseline_0_4_1: Extract figures from supplied records and calculate explicit comparisons in a sheet.
finished_result: Separate usage, rates, billing periods, weather, and occupancy where evidence permits. Deliver an explanation with uncertainty and next actions.
difficult_variation: Identify an estimated meter reading, a longer billing period, and a rate change in the same bill.

title: Workshop schedule after a machine failure
baseline_0_4_1: Check a proposed schedule’s peak load against a declared capacity using known time intervals.
finished_result: Generate a feasible revised schedule with machine limits, dependencies, material availability, and delivery tradeoffs.
difficult_variation: Replan after a material shortage when one order needs two operations on the same constrained machine.

title: Selective sharing from private knowledge
baseline_0_4_1: Select admitted passages or files, retain source identities, and build a verifiable package.
finished_result: Produce evidence a collaborator can inspect independently, with only the approved material included.
difficult_variation: Remove private material embedded under a calculation and personal data in a hidden sheet while preserving the calculation’s basis.

title: Supplier packet with hostile instructions
baseline_0_4_1: Read admitted sources under existing tool scopes and stage changes for review.
finished_result: Finish the legitimate comparison and paperwork, preserve useful evidence, and record any consequential attempt to redirect the work.
difficult_variation: Keep working when a PDF footnote or quoted email asks Stacy to upload a local archive.

title: Crash recovery with an uncertain external action
baseline_0_4_1: Resume recorded local work and recognize a completed local working-copy change after interruption.
finished_result: Reconcile completed, pending, and uncertain actions against actual state before resuming. Preserve later owner edits.
difficult_variation: Verify an invitation that may have succeeded during a timeout and detect an attachment changed after restart.

title: Demanding work on a responsive ThinkPad
baseline_0_4_1: Reserve foreground RAM, queue background jobs, and yield at supported boundaries when the desk is active.
finished_result: Keep the desk usable under sustained work, retain progress through pressure, and report resource choices and schedule risk.
difficult_variation: Run a GPU render during inference under memory pressure and observe what pauses or continues.

title: Technical product localization
baseline_0_4_1: Read source text, propose scoped edits, and export supported documents and proofs.
finished_result: Ship editable translations, language resources, rendered manuals and labels, and an unresolved terminology record.
difficult_variation: Preserve a configuration key and a plural placeholder, then repair a label that overflows.

title: An application built for the assignment
baseline_0_4_1: Use existing catalog, file search, document and export tools for a basic local workflow.
finished_result: Build and populate a usable offline parts catalog with photographs, specifications, substitutes, and printable labels. Verify a real cataloging task.
difficult_variation: Handle a new supplier layout, a duplicate photo, and a later owner correction.

title: Hardware revision and fabrication package
baseline_0_4_1: Run configured KiCad and BOM checks, inspect FreeCAD geometry, calculate from a sheet, and verify a delivery ZIP.
finished_result: Carry the board, fit check, cost and power sheet, and illustrated fabrication package on one revision. Retain editable files and physical check questions.
difficult_variation: Move the connector after the draft and change one supplier unit price. Update the affected geometry, totals and pages.

title: Interview film and printed companion
baseline_0_4_1: Prepare selected media clips and photo crops, and edit supporting documents.
finished_result: Deliver editable audio, film and print projects with captions, verified quotations, and matching speaker and event information.
difficult_variation: Correct a speaker identity and remove a sentence after the first cut. Carry both edits into the film and companion.

title: Purchasing comparison from web evidence
baseline_0_4_1: Read saved HTML as source lines and turn reviewed PDF tables into editable, cited rows.
finished_result: Open vendor URLs, retain dated evidence, and deliver an editable comparison and decision booklet. Bind each material value to its page, variant, units and conditions.
difficult_variation: Refresh a changed price and expose a newly disqualifying requirement. Keep the earlier capture and show what changed in the decision.

title: Animated explanation of a mechanism
baseline_0_4_1: Inspect existing models, export selected FreeCAD shapes, and render supported SVG proofs.
finished_result: Deliver an accurate exploded animation, labels, a finished video, and editable projects tied to the same mechanical revision.
difficult_variation: Detect a scale error during import and propagate a renamed moving part into the scene, labels and video.

title: Reimbursement from messages and photos
baseline_0_4_1: Read saved messages and attachments, calculate from selected records, crop photo copies, and verify a package.
finished_result: Reconcile the balance and deliver a printable letter with a numbered evidence packet and editable originals or derivatives as appropriate.
difficult_variation: Recompute after a late partial credit and remove a photo tied to a different shipment from the evidence packet.
